metadata.scenario: An individual calls to dispute a charge on their credit card bill for a service not received. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health. This is Margaret speaking, how can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is Karen Lewis. I’m calling because I noticed a charge on my credit card bill that I don’t understand. I’m sorry to hear that, Karen. Let’s see how I can assist you with that. I was billed for a service that I didn’t receive, and I’d like to dispute it. I understand your concern. Can you please provide me with the details of the charge? Yes, it was a charge of $95 for skilled nursing care from last week. My husband didn’t receive any visits. Thank you for that information. Let me check our records to see what might have happened. Okay, I appreciate it. I just want to make sure I’m not being billed for something we didn’t use. Absolutely, I completely understand. One moment, please. [pause] I see that the visit was scheduled but was marked as canceled by the caregiver. Canceled? We weren’t informed about that at all! I sincerely apologize for the miscommunication, Karen. Let’s resolve this for you. Thank you. So how do we handle the charge? I will initiate a refund for that charge right away. It should reflect on your card in about 5–7 business days. That’s good to know. Thank you. Of course. Also, would you like me to assist you in scheduling a follow-up visit for your husband’s care? Yes, we’ll need post-operative care after his cardiac surgery next month. Certainly, I can help with that. How about I connect you with our Care Coordinator, Lisa, for that? That would be great, thank you! I’ll transfer you to Lisa. She can help with care plan development and scheduling. Perfect, I appreciate all your help today, Margaret. You’re welcome, Karen! Just a moment while I transfer you... [pause] Lisa, I have a client on the line regarding post-operative care for her husband. [after transferring] Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health. Have a great day! Thank you!
